excerpt: Solving Seasonal Labour Shortages: Best Practices for Recruiting Agricultural Workers Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Artificial Intelligence and Recruitment, In today’s hypercompetitive talent market, 93% of Fortune 500 Chief Human Resource Officers have already integrated AI tools into their recruitment processes—and for good reason. The traditional hiring playbook is being completely rewritten as artificial intelligence transforms every stage of recruitment, from crafting job descriptions to evaluating candidates and extending offers. What once required weeks of manual resume screening and subjective decision-making can now be accomplished in hours with greater precision
